states.entryRequirements: Missing/contradictory account, security, interval or authority evidence; default
states.requiredEvidence: Gap list and exact source references where available
states.reviewer: No reviewer inferred; objective failure recorded only as technical result
states.permissionsAndRevocation: No operational use; keep blocked on missing/revoked dependency

states.entryRequirements: Integrity/schema validated retained fact and honest times; identity relation not proved
states.requiredEvidence: Pinned original bytes, account/perimeter observations and provenance
states.reviewer: Technical validation may be automated; no human acceptance inferred
states.permissionsAndRevocation: Read/research observation only, never automatic qualification

states.entryRequirements: Unique scoped proposed relationship supported by required technical identifiers and interval witnesses, no unresolved contradiction
states.requiredEvidence: Exact ledger/account/market anchors, venue/class, interval/action continuity and no duplicates
states.reviewer: Producer proposes; distinct authenticated reviewers still required

states.entryRequirements: Exact relationship scope with authentic source/identity interpretation and producer-distinct acceptance; all required intervals/current grants valid
states.requiredEvidence: Exact accepted subject/hash, reviewer/role/audit, scope, expiry/revocation and validation pins
states.reviewer: Authorized authenticated identity reviewer distinct from producer; independence verified as persons not aliases
states.permissionsAndRevocation: Identity scope only; NAVeconomics/price/publication gates remain independent

states.entryRequirements: Documented decision that this exact candidate/version is incorrect or unacceptable
states.allowedTransitions: No same-version reactivation; new version starts UNRESOLVED
states.requiredEvidence: Exact rejected subject/reasons and decision provenance
states.reviewer: Authenticated authorized review for a formal rejection; local parse failure is only blocked diagnostic
states.permissionsAndRevocation: No use; preserve immutable rejected version

states.entryRequirements: Previously accepted mapping invalidated by authentic revocation/supersession within exact scope
states.allowedTransitions: No same-version reactivation; new version starts UNRESOLVED
states.requiredEvidence: Prior decision and bound revocation/correction/supersession event
states.reviewer: Authorized authenticated revoker and current audit/role verification
states.permissionsAndRevocation: Deny downstream use immediately; retain historical audit
